Our Story

Built together. Grown with you.

Hi! We're Jayden and Ciara, a young couple with a goal of building something of our own together. We started J&C Cleaning Co. because we want to learn new skills, meet amazing people, and create an experience we can carry with us throughout life.

We're new to the professional cleaning industry, but we're committed to learning, improving, and putting genuine care into every space we work in. Every client who gives us a chance helps us grow, and we don't take that trust lightly.

We're not just looking to clean homes — we're looking to build relationships, earn trust, gain valuable experience, and grow alongside our clients.
